title: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data (fiscaldata.treasury.gov)
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
questions: how much did interest on the debt cost last year
what is the national debt today
average interest rate on marketable debt

manual.how: Run --manual-bundle (or follow --check): OUT/manual_download/treasury/INSTRUCTIONS.md lists one CSV link per dataset (no key; 10,000 rows per page, pages name_2.csv ...), curl and PowerShell commands, and the dataset page whose Download button gives the whole table as CSV/ZIP. Upload the files unchanged (not re-saved in Excel), then run --ingest.

cache.why: Queries are small to moderate and several series (MTS, DTS) are restated monthly; data/treasury/ is reused per run (as_of in the spec fixes the cut-off), nothing is cached across runs.

redistribution.why: Fiscal Data is published by the U.S. government and is in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); redistribution is permitted. Cite the source and the retrieval date, because Treasury revises some series.

citation: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service, Fiscal Data (https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov), {dataset}; retrieved {retrieved_long} through the Fiscal Data API.
clarify: Fiscal year (October to September, the budget convention) or calendar year?
Which debt measure: debt held by the public (economic analysis), total public debt outstanding ("the national debt"), or debt subject to the statutory limit?
Nominal dollars, real dollars (CPI-U, latest full fiscal year) or a share of GDP? Over a decade or more the answer can change.
Which interest measure: net interest (MTS, the budget measure), gross interest expense (what Treasury pays), or interest on debt held by the public only?

Tax refunds: cash paid (DTS, refundable credits included) or the budget-basis refunds that offset receipts (MTS Table 4)? Default: the measure the question names; else DTS cash refunds, with MTS as the cross-check.
Program measure: the budget function (MTS Table 9) or CBO's program figure (benefits only, net of offsetting receipts)? Default: the budget function, with CBO's figure as the cross-check.
